Hi Lauren,

Following up from the loop last week: Archie (candidate) completed final loop with the runtime team and the hiring panel is unanimous — strong match for an immediate IC4 impact on serving & runtime. He has a competing offer that beats our typical IC3/IC4 midpoint by ~18%. I've attached a comp proposal (v1) and his resume.

Ask: approve a payband exception to the upper IC4 range (base $235k, target total comp $320k incl. equity + sign-on). If we can't get sign-off for the full ask, would like guidance on the max we can offer quickly — recruiter needs DocuSign link by end of day Friday.

Key bullets:
- Role: Senior Inference Engineer (runtime) — hiring manager: me
- Reason for exception: market comp + rare deep-attention kernel experience
- Recruiting asks: expedite — candidate asked for final answer by 9/10

Attachments: comp_proposal_archie_v1.pdf, archie_singh_resume.pdf

Thanks — appreciate a quick read.

—
Marissa Cole

Marissa —

Thanks for the context and the packet. A couple quick asks before I can greenlight:
1) Please add a short market comp note: two recent hires in Bay Area for similar scope and their realized OTEs (anonymized) so I can justify the delta in the exception memo.
2) Confirm the proposed leveling (IC4) vs IC3 stretch — is this a permanent level change or an interim comp exception?
3) Any constraints on equity or sign-on budget — do we need People Ops pre-approval for above-band equity?

If this is time-sensitive, copy Viv for exec sign-off if the base goes above our published IC4 max. Once I have the bench numbers I'll draft the exception memo and route for signature.

Linking our comp doc for reference: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/comp/2026-paybands.pdf

Brief summary to save time:
- Market comps (Bay Area, late-stage startups): realized base range for similar roles $210k–$240k; realized OTE $280k–$350k.
- Level recommendation: IC4 permanent hire (growth + ownership expected).
- Equity: within IC4 band but above standard target — proposed 0.55% with standard 4-year vest + 12-month cliff.

Marissa / Lauren —

Thanks for the packet and the clear rationale. I reviewed the comps and the candidate notes. I'm comfortable approving an exception with the following conditions:

- Approve base up to $235,000 and total cash (base + sign-on) up to $265,000. Equity allocation approved at 0.45% (slightly below ask) — keep within comp pool constraints.
- Candidate to be leveled IC4 permanently.
- Offer must include a 6-month performance checkpoint tied to potential accelerated equity refresh if targets met.
- Final offer letter to be prepared by Mina; any compensation outside these caps requires my re-approval.

Please proceed; Mina — can you draft the offer with these terms and loop People Ops for processing? We should get DocuSign to the candidate today.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platform Engineering
